plan.title: Scholarship Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship applicants by status, marks, income, and talukas

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applicants by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average Marks by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average Family Income by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", AVG("Family Income") AS avg_income FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applicants by Taluka
panels.sql: SELECT "Taluka", COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides an overview of the scholarship applicants. The total number of applicants is {{p1}}. The distribution of applicants by status is shown in panel {{p2}}, with the average marks for each status in panel {{p3}}. Panel {{p4}} displays the average family income by status. Finally, panel {{p5}} highlights the top talukas with the most applicants.
